core_problems: Siloed service perception: Users treat CloudIVR as disjointed utilities (just a number OR just an eSIM) instead of a connected business communication engine.
Hidden cross-sell potential: Quick IVR setup, Telegram bot integration, softphone credentials, and AI receptionist features are buried in secondary menus.
High cognitive load on onboarding: First-time users struggle to pick between virtual landlines, USA texting numbers, and fax-only lines without guided intent.
Inconsistent visual hierarchy: Dark mode defaults caused harsh contrast for daytime corporate users; light theme needs a calm, professional, high-trust tone.

motion_and_interactions.principles: Lightweight, functional transitions with spring physics. Avoid distracting high-speed loops.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Cards lift on hover (-translate-y-1) with soft ambient shadow (shadow-card-hover). Buttons have smooth background transition (duration-150 ease-out).
motion_and_interactions.click_feedback: Active button state uses scale-[0.98] transform for crisp tactile response.
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: Focus visible triggers ring-2 ring-blue-500/20 ring-offset-2 for screen reader accessibility.
motion_and_interactions.prefers_reduced_motion: All transitions degrade gracefully to standard opacity fades when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use light theme CSS variables from /app/frontend/src/cloudivr/theme-light.css with fallback hex values where necessary.
Keep React .js file conventions (JSX without TypeScript types).
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, nav links) include kebab-case data-testid attributes for testing.
Apply 'civr-card', 'civr-btn', 'civr-btn-primary', 'civr-input', and 'civr-pill' base classes across components.
Verify that header overlays and dropdown menus never use transparent backgrounds without backdrop blur or solid white background.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never center align the entire app container.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6) between cards and grid containers.
Ensure all interactive states provide clear hover, active, and focus visual cues.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to buttons, links, inputs, and tabs.
